title: Open Air Mexican Nectarine Wrap
description: A fresh, tangy wrap that showcases Sonoran flavors with sweet nectarines, crisp veggies, and lightly steamed corn tortillas.
instructions: Prepare the ingredients by dicing the nectarines, chopping the cucumber and bell pepper, thinly slicing the red onion, slicing the avocado, and chopping the cilantro.
Whisk together the lime juice, chili powder, garlic powder, and olive oil in a bowl to create the dressing.
Toss the diced nectarines, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, avocado, and cilantro with the dressing until well coated.
Heat a steamer basket over medium heat and lay each corn tortilla flat, brushing it lightly with olive oil, then steam for 30 seconds on each side until softened.
Lay a steamed tortilla on a flat surface, place a spoonful of the nectarine mixture in the center, fold the sides over, and roll into a tight wrap.
Repeat the wrapping process with the remaining tortillas and arrange all wraps on a platter.
If desired, sprinkle shredded lettuce over the tops of the wraps and squeeze a little fresh lime juice over each one.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to one hour before serving.
Enjoy the light, tangy flavors of this open‑air Mexican nectarine wrap.
